name: Mousse Atlas
source:
Devoted & Sleepy Veteran

He's currently a diplomat and was the former Ace of Hearts.
He loves naps so he sleeps every chance he gets. He studies diligently to fulfill his dream. He tells you he's fallen for you at first sight but is it true...?

"...You're adorable. I've fallen for you at first sight so will you go out with me?"

[From in-game profile]
